purpose: Verified contract for citizen-facing explanation of the legal effect of an approved property event.
event_rule: Factual event and legal effect are separate layers.
authority_rule: The stated legal effect requires the applicable legal provision or authoritative case-law proposition.
temporal_rule: Historical effect uses the law applicable at the relevant time, including material commencement and transitional rules.
condition_rule: Material conditions, exceptions, provisos and savings remain visible.
registration_rule: Registration requirements remain distinct from signing, execution, possession and contractual effect.
scope_rule: Legal effect is limited to what evidence and authority establish.
non_effect_rule: Material things the event did not establish or accomplish are explicitly identified.
conflict_rule: Unresolved evidence or legal-authority conflicts prevent a definitive legal-effect statement.
verification_boundary: The engine explains approved legal effects and non-effects; it does not create a new legal conclusion.
